prisoners.name: Mary Rider
prisoners.description:
Mary Rider is an activist documented in Nuclear Resister’s reporting on protest arrests.

On 2026-03-27, Mary Rider was arrested at Pentagon. Arrested during the Patrick O’Neill birthday peace witness at the Pentagon. Processing and release of the group took more than seven hours; this is not recorded as a full-day prison sentence. June court dates were scheduled, with no individual final disposition established here.
prisoners.body:
Verified detail sources (October 9, 2026, continued review): The Georgia Bulletin identifies Mary Rider as Patrick O’Neill’s wife and uses feminine biographical references. National Catholic Reporter’s interview uses she/her for the same Catholic Worker cofounder. The Pentagon witness report independently identifies Rider and her daughter Bernadette Naro in the March 2026 arrest. Other arrest episodes are not merged into this case. Source 1. Source 2. Source 3.

Portrait provenance

Mary Rider, explicitly identified beside her speaker biography for the Creating a Holistic Culture of Life conference. The biography identifies the Garner Catholic Worker cofounder, social worker and wife of Patrick O'Neill, and discusses her nonviolent protest arrests. Original photographer and photograph date unspecified. Original-pixel trim removes a one-pixel outer edge; her full hair and face are retained. No resizing, retouching or generated details.
